data.name: Kunal
data.gender_notes: Kunal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kūñala’, meaning black lotus or coal. This name is associated with Lord Shiva and carries deep spiritual significance. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often depicted as having a blue throat from consuming the poisonous Halahala. This color symbolizes the purity and strength of the god. The name Kunal embodies these powerful and transformative qualities.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, transformation, and spiritual purity

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kunal total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
